sentences.text: Katherine Matilda `` Tilda '' Swinton -LRB- born 5 November 1960 -RRB- is a British actress , performance artist , model , and fashion muse , known for her roles in independent and Hollywood films .	performance artist	performance artist	independent	independent film	Hollywood films	Hollywood

She is the recipient of two BAFTA Awards , one BIFA Award , an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress and has received three nominations for a Golden Globe Award .
